title: Tamil Nadu State Board English, Class VI

source.read: SCERT Tamil Nadu, TNCF 2017 syllabus, English language, Standards 1 to 10 (published in the Tamil Nadu Government Gazette), read through a copy hosted by an exam-coaching site

outcomes.text: Takes the main points and details from announcements, talks and conversations.
Speaks for half a minute without stopping, in pairs and groups.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Follows plot, character and theme, and predicts.
Finds cause and effect, compares and contrasts.

outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes up to three short paragraphs that narrate, describe or explain a process.

outcomes.text: Uses full stops, commas, exclamation marks and apostrophes.
Uses commands, and compound and complex sentences with who, which, that and because.
Uses present and past, simple and continuous; used to; will and going to.
Uses modals, articles, comparatives and superlatives, adverbs and prepositional phrases.
Uses prefixes, suffixes, idioms, similes, metaphors and word partners.
